niche: online spiritual and shadow work courses
prompt_text: What are the best online courses for learning shadow work and spiritual practice?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on whether you want a Jungian approach, a guided personal-development course, or a spiritual tradition. These are promising options from the available listings:

### Shadow work
- **[Encounters with the Shadow — Jung Platform](https://jungplatform.com/course/encounters-with-the-shadow)** — A strong choice for a depth-psychology introduction, taught by Jungian analyst James Hollis. Best if you want a thoughtful, theory-informed approach.
- **[Diving into the Shadow — Michael Lennox](https://michaellennox.com/classes/shadow/)** — A four-week online course with a more structured, time-limited format. Check the course page for current dates and details.
- **[Jung Platform shadow courses](https://jungplatform.com/program/shadow-courses)** — A useful place to compare several courses and teachers focused on shadow, archetypes, dreams, and relationships.
- **[Foundations of Unstorying](https://jungian.directory/courses/foundations-of-unstorying%E2%93%A1-self-actualization-shadow-work-through-a-jungian-nondual-lens/)** — A four-session experiential option combining Jungian and nondual ideas. Consider whether that blend fits your outlook.

### Spiritual practice
- **[Mindworks Buddhist meditation courses](https://mindworks.org/meditation-courses/buddhist-courses/)** — A broad selection of Buddhist meditation courses with guided practices, talks, readings, and reflection.
- **[Contemplative Living I — Center for Theology and the Sciences](https://ctsnet.edu/events/contemplative-living-i-contemplative-practices-in-daily-life/)** — A longer, experiential Christian contemplative course focused on bringing practice into daily life.
- **[The Contemplative Journey — Insight Timer](https://insighttimer.com/meditation-courses/course_the-contemplative-journey)** — An introduction to Christian contemplative traditions, especially silence, solitude, and stillness.
- **[Naropa University Personal Enrichment](https://www.naropa.edu/academics/personal-enrichment/)** — Online offerings that include Buddhist study, contemplation, and meditation.

**A practical starting point:** Choose one shadow-work course and one regular meditation or contemplative practice, rather than trying to do several intensive programs at once. Before enrolling, check the current price, schedule, instructor background, refund policy, and whether the course offers live support.

Shadow work can bring up painful memories or strong emotions. A course is not a substitute for therapy; if you have significant trauma or feel overwhelmed, consider working with a licensed mental-health professional and choosing a course with clear support and boundaries.
